theme: All themes · Low Tide · The Last Letter
note: The fifth joint session gave Beatriz her reading of the flooded codex on the third attempt, as the room had expected, five to four over Dae-ho's reply between the walkers. Five sessions over the whole archive produced ten fusions and nothing that stayed in one theme; the room agreed this had been the point.

proposals.direction: Read the flooded codex. Paint a staff gauge on the wax seal and copy the sixty-four tiles' water levels onto a reading card beside the grid, so a letter that became a shore can be measured like one.
proposals.rationale: Third attempt. A flat that is also a table should be read as one, and after the twentieth day was lifted out of the table and held, the room wanted the rest of the readings taken.

proposals.direction: Answer the sentence: a second line of light from the dark walker back to the pale one, steadier, crossing the first.
proposals.rationale: A sentence between two people deserves a reply; he asked the same of the codex.

proposals.direction: Write the reading on the held card in the shaking hand, one unreadable number.
proposals.rationale: The one thing nobody has been able to write, in the hand that cannot be read.

proposals.direction: Let the flood begin to fill the signature creek from the sea end, water rising along the stem.
proposals.rationale: Water, erasing a signature the only way it knows.

proposals.direction: A crab pressed beside the kelp, flattened like the weed.
